prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1231; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the left-hand lane on a Pearland, Texas roadway when the vehicle moved over to the right lane without a visible signal, contacting the side of Driver 2's vehicle as it passed. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder following the impact and was assessed at the scene. The reported injury is consistent with the type and force of a sideswipe collision of this kind. Both vehicles displayed scrape marks and paint transfer along the right side of Driver 1's vehicle and the left rear quarter panel of Driver 2's vehicle, and the damage pattern matches the impact described by both drivers. Photographs taken at the scene confirm the general positions of the vehicles and the damage observed. No independent witnesses were located who saw the collision itself. Officers confirmed that the Passenger was seated in the vehicle at the time of the crash, a fact also confirmed by Driver 2. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was known to either party or noted during the inspection. Driver 1 is listed as an insured driver on the policy covering the vehicle.
